texts: Week 4 Menu is up. Three quarterbacks and five lead backs are off the menu, Jaylen Warren is a top-10 back Thursday with Dowdle on two missed practices, and Jayden Daniels sits outside the top 24 until he practices. Start Warren. Let's look into it. #HereWeGo #RaiseHail

QB. Tier 1: Allen. Tier 2: Jackson, Lawrence. Tier 3 opens with Burrow, who gets JAX at home, the softest quarterback spot of the week; all three CIN touchdowns last week were passes. Start all four. #BillsMafia #RavensFlock #DUUUVAL #WhoDey

QB tier 3, continued: Shough, Prescott, Hurts. Shough threw 4 scores vs LV and gets a Monday night without Etienne. With Daniels unready, Marcus Mariota is the WAS quarterback on the menu; stream him in London if you are stuck. #Saints #DallasCowboys #FlyEaglesFly #RaiseHail

RB. Tier 1: Gibbs, Robinson. Tier 2: Walker, McCaffrey, Henry. Walker had 18 for 70, two rushing scores and a receiving touchdown last week; Gibbs draws the defense giving up the most to backs. Start all five. #OnePride #DirtyBirds #ChiefsKingdom #FTTB #RavensFlock

RB tier 2, continued: Taylor, Cook, Jeanty, Brown. Tier 3 opens with Jaylen Warren: 90 percent of the snaps and 20 touches with Dowdle out, and Dowdle has not practiced this week. Start Warren as an RB1 Thursday. #ForTheShoe #BillsMafia #RaiderNation #WhoDey #HereWeGo

WR. Tier 1: Smith-Njigba, Chase. Tier 2: St. Brown. Smith-Njigba's 37.9 percent target share leads the league by four points, and St. Brown gets a CAR secondary missing two starters on Sunday night. Start all three. #Seahawks #WhoDey #OnePride #KeepPounding

WR tier 3: Olave, Lamb, London, Flowers, Garrett Wilson. Olave has 36 targets in three games and one touchdown; the scores catch up Monday night. Flowers is off the snap count. Start all five. #Saints #DallasCowboys #DirtyBirds #RavensFlock #JetUp

TE tier 1: Bowers, McBride. Specials: Hubbard (20 carries, every first-half snap) start as your RB2; Aaron Jones Sr. (78 percent of the carries) start as your RB2; Downs (targets 3, 9, 11) start as a WR2. #RaiderNation #BirdGang #KeepPounding #Skol #ForTheShoe

Off the menu. Caleb Williams (hamstring, 3 to 4 weeks): pivot to Jared Goff. Baker Mayfield (thumb, 3-plus weeks): pivot to Sam Darnold. De'Von Achane (ACL, IR): pivot to Ollie Gordon II, 84 percent of the snaps after he left. #DaBears #OnePride #GoBucs #Seahawks #PhinsUp
Full menu, all tiers, updated Friday with the injury report. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.
